title: Workspace authority recovery: stable instance identity and review snapshot preflight

included: stable workspace_instance_id based on owner plus physical checkout root
workspace registration upsert that preserves existing provenance on incomplete re-registration
HTTP client forwarding of daemon-published snapshot provenance
task.report rejection before state mutation when snapshot provenance is absent

root_causes.summary: Workspace instance identity included Git HEAD and changed for the same physical checkout after a commit.
workspace.register used INSERT OR REPLACE and incomplete client registration could erase persisted snapshot and Git provenance.
task.report allowed an empty snapshot_id, creating a review state that no provenance-valid reviewer verdict could consume.

implementation.change: Separate stable physical checkout identity from mutable Git/snapshot provenance and merge registration provenance with an UPSERT.
Forward snapshot metadata during registration and automatically obtain a daemon-issued snapshot before HTTP task.report.
Reject empty task.report snapshot_id before task, step, or event state changes.
Cover no-snapshot report rejection and unchanged in_progress state.
Keep a valid snapshot on the report used by handoff provenance coverage.

source_verification.command: tokenslim run cargo test --manifest-path rust_ext/Cargo.toml daemon::task_collab::tests::core --lib

source_verification.result: passed (2 tests); verifies daemon DB-path lookup, snapshot publication forwarding, and fail-closed missing-path handling

required: fresh daemon registration preserves one workspace instance across repeated registration
snapshot.publish returns a non-empty authority snapshot
task.report enters review only after all task steps complete and carries the authority snapshot
independent reviewer can consume the review input without no_snapshot
